subject: CloudWard: Request for multi-cloud pilot onboarding credit & packaging flexibility
messages:
From: Maria Alvarez <maria@cloudward.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudward.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot ask — multi-cloud packaging + onboarding credit

Hi Sean / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the evaluation across our AWS and GCP staging clusters and the latency profiles look promising. We have two asks from our procurement and platform teams before we can sign a formal pilot:

1) A one-time onboarding credit to offset initial consumption spikes for the first 90 days (estimated 150k tokens/month).
2) Permission to run Redwood in a partner-managed dedicated VPC for the pilot and a temporary variance to the seat/seat-license packaging so we can add 5 shared operator seats.

Attached is our RFP matrix (CloudWard_RFP_Matrix.pdf) and a short usage forecast. Procurement is asking for a commercial note and approval path — if you can get VP/CFO sign-off for an exception, we can move to legal and DocuSign.

Regards,
Maria
Maria Alvarez
Head of Platform Partnerships, CloudWard
[Attachment: CloudWard_RFP_Matrix.pdf]

Maria — thanks for the clear ask and the RFP. Looping in pricing (Aditya) and commercial ops (Laura) to scope the exception. Internal note below for the team — forwarding your email into that thread.

Internal ask: we need VP/CFO sign-off for a limited onboarding credit + packaging variance. Key constraints: 90-day credit window, ability to run in partner-managed VPC, and temporary seat-sharing for 5 operators. Can pricing build a short memo with cost impact and proposed guardrails?

Thanks — Sean

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:10:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Pilot ask — multi-cloud packaging + onboarding credit (pricing analysis)

Team — quick pricing sketch attached (redwood-proposal-v3.xlsx). Relevant bullets:  

- Proposed onboarding credit: 40% consumption credit (applied to token charges) for first 90 days, capped at $45k total.
- Required commercial commitment: 18-month minimum with a 12k/mo committed token floor after pilot converts. If they do not commit, credit will be clawed back prorated.
- Packaging variance: allow 5 shared operator seats for pilot (no additional per-seat uplift beyond standard seat price) with a 90-day review.
- Partner-managed VPC: allowed for pilot but must pass our security checklist; Redwood will require audit logging and a limited support window (M-F 9-5 PT).

Impact: worst-case credit realization $45k; upside: conversion probability increases significantly, and the ARR cadence for an 18-month commitment is favorable. I recommend a one-time commercial exception memo to VP/CFO + a short addendum for legal.

[Attachment: redwood-proposal-v3.xlsx]

– Aditya
Pricing Lead

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Exception memo for VP/CFO — CloudWard pilot credit request

Marissa — draft exception memo below for your review / sign-off. Summary first, full rationale after.

Summary ask:
- Approve a one-time onboarding credit equal to 40% of token charges for the first 90 days of the pilot, capped at $45,000.
- Approve packaging variance to allow 5 shared operator seats for the pilot period (90 days).
- Authorize partner-managed dedicated VPC for the pilot subject to security checklist.

Rationale:
- Strategic fit: CloudWard is a 600-employee platform integrator with a strong channel reach into mid-market healthcare customers. Their go-to-market includes a marketplace channel that can accelerate Redwood adoption across 30+ prospects in H1.
- Risk mitigation: credit is capped and conditional on a signed 18-month commitment with a 12k/mo committed token floor; failure to commit triggers clawback.
- Cost: modeled incremental cost (GPU cycles + support overhead) across the pilot is ~ $32k; cap protects downside.

Proposed guardrails / contract language to legal:
1) Credit applied only to token consumption line item; not refundable.
2) 18-month minimum contract must be fully executed within 45 days of pilot start to avoid clawback.
3) Redwood retains the right to revert packaging to standard seat licensing at 90-day review.

Attachments: redwood-proposal-v3.xlsx (pricing), usage-forecast_Q4.csv (client estimate).

Please confirm if you approve this pathway or would like a lower cap / alternate structure. If approved, Aditya + Legal will update the SOW/addendum and we will send a commercial note to Maria.

Thanks,
Priyom
Commercial Operations

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Exception memo for VP/CFO — CloudWard pilot credit request

Thanks for the concise memo. I approve the exception with the following conditions:

1) Reduce credit cap from $45k -> $35k.
2) Add escrowed clawback clause in SOW (pro-rated return if commitment not executed).
3) Add a usage SLA table in SOW that includes a soft cost-recovery clause if consumption exceeds forecast by >200% to protect the platform.

If Legal confirms language for 2) and 3) we can sign off. Please get the adjusted doc back to me by EOD tomorrow.

Marissa
VP, Finance (Commercial)
Redwood Inference

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@cloudward.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 15:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — multi-cloud packaging + onboarding credit

Maria — good news: we have provisional approval from our finance team for a constrained onboarding credit and packaging variance. High-level approved items: 

- Onboarding credit: 40% token credit for first 90 days capped at $35,000.
- Packaging: pilot allowance for 5 shared operator seats for 90 days.
- Partner-managed VPC permitted for the pilot pending our security checklist.

Next steps: 1) Legal will prepare a short addendum that includes an escrowed clawback clause and a usage SLA table (legal will be in touch). 2) We will send a formal commercial note and DocuSign once the addendum is ready.

If that aligns, can you confirm pilot start window (preferred week of Dec 13) and we will kick off onboarding.

Best,
Sean
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
